image_description: A close-up, angled view of a transparent plastic audio cassette tape. The internal mechanism, including black spools and reddish-brown magnetic tape, is visible through the clear casing. A white paper label with handwritten text ('50', '15/2') is affixed to the top face, alongside a pink rectangular sticker or insert on the left side. The lighting creates strong specular highlights and reflections on the glossy plastic surface.
